text:
inc-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed on inference-gateway-prod. Alerting on >5% 5xx for 3m. Paging @oncall-bob :rotating_light:

oncall-bob: got the page, I'm on it. Can someone grab recent graphs (latency, 5xx by route)?

mike: looking now — Grafana shows a sharp spike starting at 2024-04-26T17:12Z. 5xx is concentrated on /v1/generate routed to pool-inference-3.

sarah: logs show a bunch of backend connection resets and HTTP 503 from the pool. At the same time envoy retries count increased ~3x.

david: I think this started right after the LB rollout at ~17:10. The new route weights moved traffic to pool-inference-3 and we bumped retry_policy to aggressive during canary.

eva: concrete snippet from the route config (from control plane):

```
route_config:
  name: inference-routes
  virtual_hosts:
  - name: api
    routes:
    - match: { prefix: "/v1/generate" }
      route:
        cluster: pool-inference-3
        retry_policy:
          retry_on: 5xx,connect,reset
          num_retries: 4
```

jasmine: that retry_on + num_retries=4 + heavier weight -> downstream overload and saturating connections on pool-inference-3, then CB tripping and 5xx cascade.

oncall-bob: ok immediate mitigation options? We need to reduce customer impact quickly.

mike: we can roll back the route weight change (control-plane) or patch the route to set `num_retries: 0` for /v1/generate. Fastest is to disable retries at the LB.

sarah: agree — set `num_retries: 0` and shorten circuit breaker timeouts so unhealthy hosts get ejected faster.

david: I'm ready to apply a hotfix. Proposed patch (kubectl patch to configmap in gateway service):

```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-config --type merge -p '"{\"data\":{\"retry_policy\":\"num_retries: 0\"}}"'
```

(oncall-bob note: that exact command depends on our config layering, proceed carefully)

eva: I'll do a controlled change: update the control-plane route and push a patch to 3 instances, then monitor 1m. If metrics improve, rollout across cluster.

jasmine: add a temporary route shadow to the healthy pool (pool-inference-1) as a fallback if rollback isn't instant.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by eva at 2024-04-26T17:20Z — rolling update to 3/3 pods.

mike: seeing 5xx drop to ~1.2% after first instance patched. Latency stable.

eva: rolled patch to all instances, `num_retries: 0` now in prod for /v1/generate. Circuit breaker thresholds tightened too (`max_requests: 500 -> 200`).

oncall-bob: good. continuing monitoring for 10m. Any customer-facing impact? Which customers hit the route most?

sarah: internal telemetry: 35% of requests for this route came from tiered-pro customers (billing-streams). We'll prepare an update for SRE-Support to notify affected accounts proactively.

david: root cause: combination of weight shift + aggressive retries overwhelmed pool-inference-3 causing connection resets and CB thrashing. Action items: 1) revert weight increment and re-evaluate canary policy, 2) add a preflight for retry_policy in rollout (block if pool utilization > 60%), 3) add a circuit-breaker autoscale signal.

oncall-bob: assigning tasks — david to revert canary weight (if not auto-rolled back), mike to craft postmortem skeleton, sarah to prepare customer impact note, eva to follow up on deploy details. I'll hand off to next on-call in 30m.

jasmine: small note — we should also consider limiting `retry_on` to `connect,reset` only (remove 5xx) to avoid retry amplifying upstream 5xx.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded at 2024-04-26T17:23Z — all pods updated.

mike: metrics look stable 10m after patch. 5xx back to baseline (<0.5%).

oncall-bob: handing off to @oncall-sarah in 30m with summary, marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. Will create an incident channel for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

sarah: noted, I'll take the handoff and start drafting the RCA. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

inc-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated — retries disabled for /v1/generate, circuit breakers tightened, route weights reverted. Impact was limited (transient 5xx spike). Postmortem channel: #incident-1716504321-rca
